snippet.title: NodalBastion – Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3944520/NodalBastion/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=wishlist

Coming March 2026

NodalBastion is a minimalist survival strategy game where you defend the last AI core against evolving humanity.  
Build your bastion with a network of nodes, collect resources, unlock upgrades, and unleash devastating abilities.

#PitchYaGame submission, heya all! :0
